name: iphone-use
description: Local fork with checkpointed, paced touch execution and an external trajectory planner. Read and operate a real iPhone over USB or Wi-Fi; repetitive work uses explicit page checks and stops on uncertain outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent operate a real iPhone
interface.longDescription: Operate the apps on your own iPhone that have no API: Health, banking, chat apps and the rest. The iphone-use daemon on your Mac drives the phone through its own XCTest runner over USB or Wi-Fi. The agent reads each screen as a text list of elements, acts on what it names, and replays saved per-app flows in one call. The daemon is installed separately with one curl line; iphone-use doctor then says what the Mac, Xcode or the phone still needs.
defaultPrompt: Install iphone-use, run iphone-use doctor, and walk me through anything it says I have to do on the phone.
Check that my iPhone is drivable, then open Settings and tell me which iOS version it runs.
用 iPhone Use 打开健康 App，告诉我今天走了多少步。
